description: This file contains device definitions, build instructions, and variable configurations specific to TP-Link devices within an OpenWrt build system. It includes macros for creating images, device-specific parameters, and instructions for building device images such as factory and sysupgrade binaries.

methods.name: Build/tplink-v1-okli-image
methods.description: Build macro for creating TP-Link OKLI images, copying kernel and root filesystem, and invoking the firmware creation tool with device-specific parameters.

methods.name: Build/uImage-tplink-c9
methods.description: Build macro for creating U-Boot images for TP-Link devices using mkimage.
